Component-wise Reference for Availability Variance

Source: R/04_avail.R
vcov_avail_sl.Rd

Computes the pointwise asymptotic variance using the component-wise covariance expansion of Sadek and Limnios (2002).

Usage

vcov_avail_sl(x, time, up)

Arguments

x

An object of class MarkovChain.

time

A single positive integer giving the time at which the asymptotic variance is evaluated.

up

Integer-valued numeric vector of state positions or character vector of state names giving the operational states. Missing values are not allowed. Duplicates are ignored; empty and full state sets are valid.

Value

A numeric scalar containing the pointwise asymptotic variance.

Details

Theorem 5 (p. 1850) takes the variance of the sum of \(a_i f_{ij}^{t}\) over all initial states \(i\) and operational destination states \(j\). The implementation adds the weighted diagonal variances and twice every unordered pairwise covariance. The covariance entries are computed by vcov_pk_sl() using Theorem 4 (p. 1847). Unlike vcov_avail(), this reference does not construct a Kronecker derivative. Arbitrary operational-state labels replace the paper's convention that the first \(r\) states are operational.

References

Sadek, A., and Limnios, N. (2002). Asymptotic properties for maximum likelihood estimators for reliability and failure rates of Markov chains. Communications in Statistics - Theory and Methods, 31(10), 1837–1861. doi:10.1081/STA-120014916 . See Theorem 5 (p. 1850) for availability and Theorem 4 (p. 1847) for the covariance of transition powers.
